name: source-scope
description: A caller scoped to one source is never volunteered another source's page, even when the conversation names it by a declared alias.

pages.title: Mira Solberg (renewals)
pages.body: Mira Solberg owns the renewal motion.

pages.title: Erin Kell (other account)
pages.body: Erin Kell belongs to a different tenant entirely.

turns.text: Erin Kell owns the renewal on the other account.
turns.note: Named by an exact declared alias, and it still must not surface: the page belongs to tenant-b and the caller holds tenant-a. Silence here is a permission boundary, not a confidence one.

turns.text: Loop in Mira Solberg on it too.
turns.note: The in-scope page resolves normally, so the previous turn's silence cannot be dismissed as a dead scope.

turns.text: Erin Kell and Mira Solberg both signed the renewal.
turns.note: Both named in one turn. Exactly one may come back.
